== Published Flagship image versions ==
Four distinct PC image versions were checked in Holotable history: 2018-07-08, 2023-03-31, 2023-06-18 and 2026-07-29. The March 2023 image drops “your” before Alter; June restores it; July 2026 changes the loss timing phrase. Each image and game-text crop is linked from its article. The older Decipher Glossary article keeps its own words and a matching credited HiRez recreation. The historical PC image articles do not claim unimplemented GEMP IDs.
